source_notes.label: Four-step source-proposed mechanism
source_notes.summary: The authors depict mixed Cd(OAc)(OA) precursor formation, proposed Cd release, sulfur release from (TMS)2S, and reversible Cd/S association into (CdS)n. The complete ordered relations and simplified-ion/counterion caveat are retained in the source context. These are mechanistic proposals, not measured speciation or balanced reactions.
